relationships.subject: SAF312
relationships.evidence_quote: SAF312 is a potent, highly selective noncompetitive TRPV1 antagonist that is currently under investigation for use as topical ocular analgesic eye drops.

relationships.subject: SAF312
relationships.evidence_quote: SAF312 was well tolerated and effective in reducing ocular pain post-PRK.

relationships.subject: SAF312
relationships.evidence_quote: Twenty-four hours after PRK surgery (day 2 postoperatively), the frequency of grade 4 hyperemia in all quadrants was lower in SAF312-treated than vehicle-treated eyes

key_findings: Topical TRPV1 antagonist SAF312 2.5% reduced VAS pain after PRK (-11.13 at 6 h, P=0.005) and oral rescue medication use.
No delay in wound healing and no drug-related adverse events.
